mapper.sql: u.username, u.teamname, u.level AS user_level, CASE WHEN u.level = 1 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(u.teamname, ''), NULLIF(u.display_name, ''), CONCAT('团队用户#', r.user_id)) WHEN u.level = 2 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(u.display_name, ''), CONCAT('学生用户#', r.user_id)) WHEN u.level = 0 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(u.display_name, ''), '系统管理员') ELSE CONCAT('用户#', r.user_id) END AS display_name

mapper.update: UPDATE reply SET content_status = #{newStatus}, status = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'REMOVED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, reviewed_by_user_id = #{actorUserId}, reviewed_at = NOW(), review_reason_code = #{reasonCode}, review_note = #{note}, removed_by_user_id = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'REMOVED' THEN #{actorUserId} ELSE NULL END, removed_at = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'REMOVED' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, removal_reason_code = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'REMOVED' THEN #{reasonCode} ELSE NULL END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND content_status <> 'REMOVED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user actor WHERE actor.id = #{actorUserId} AND actor.level = 0 )
